notes.title: Bloody visual Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Updated the visuals of the game to a more bloody, ghostly look.
[/list]

notes.title: Endless Mode and Music Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The Endless Mode option allows run to last more than the 3 Ascension Cycles the standard run has. Challengers continue to appear with their effects stacking over time and Ascensions spawn more and more bosses the further the player reaches.
[*]Instead of creating a run with a set Ruleset, Hard+ runs increase the number of rules the run has with each Ascension completion.
[*] Menu music aswell as run music has been updated.
[/list]

notes.title: Graphical update 2
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Updated the enemy models.
[*]Updated the Entity model.
[*]Rescaled the player and enemy size.
[*]Fixed the rain not activating in certain maps.
[*]Fixed enemy deformations.
[*]Improved gambling/loot box lighting intensity.
[/list]
